svg.title: 03 extension native compact v4 page03
svg.desc: Phenome extension: points and uncertainty. Page 3 contains 13 outcome rows and all12 sleep columns in frozen order, showing rg and SE. Dots: original complete-family BH q < 0.05. Both panels use fixed scales across pages. Exact values and marginal 95% intervals are in the table. No covariance-adjusted contrast is shown. Act. = actigraphy. Source and ancestry qualifications remain.
